title: Empty tab canvas — the from-scratch template
description: One empty measure of a tab-capable guitar part: no notes, no time signature, no tuning (consumers assume standard), no clef. This is the editor's document-genesis template (roadmap/inprogress/editor-input-layer.md): from-scratch trace fixtures start here, set up time signature and tuning through EditOps, and enter notes onto the empty grid. Also pins that an empty-content sequence is schema-valid and renderable.
